strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So this is Bardos Island... This is where they were hiding?
Hey, Tetsuya! Don't leave me behind! There's only two of us here!
We've found Mykene's main base...
We can't dawdle and let them get away!
Even so...
Jun... why do you think we've trained since we were kids and come this far?
That's...
Defeating Mykene is our mission. That's... We'll talk later, Jun!
Huh?
You did well to find this place...
Show yourself! Marshal of Hell!
Patience, Tetsuya Tsurugi. Our Mechanical and Battle Beasts await.
A pincer attack? How old-fashioned. Marshal of Hell... no, Dr. Hell!
I'll make today the last day of your Mykene Empire...!
No, you're wrong...!
Today will be the last day of Great Mazinger!
Great General of Darkness!? Quit hiding and show yourself!
Only the two of you? You can hardly be in your right minds.
Heh. For the likes of you, Great Mazinger alone is plenty!
Honestly, with us surrounded like this, I'm not so sure...
Fwahaha... I shall at least build you a grave...
So die in peace!
Ready, Jun? Let's go!
Ready! Tetsuya!
Ooooohhh! Koji Kabuto!
It's over... Baron Ashura...!
Oh, Dr. Hell... Forgive me! Ashura... Ashura has...!
Gwaaah! I've been...!?
You looked down on me, on all of us, to the end. So you lose, Brocken!
Curse you! Remember this! Next time, I'll surely...
Oh... ohhh... I... who was revived... as the Marshal of Hell...
Dr. Hell...! To think this island... would end up being your grave...
Heh heh... heh... Yes... This is where it all began... Koji... Kabuto...
...And this is where it ends.
Heh heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Kabuto, I'm coming to see you,
Hwaa ha ha ha ha!
...What... What is this...? Koji Kabuto... Tetsuya Tsurugi...! You...!
Great General of Darkness! As your name says, return to the darkness...!
Gh... How bitter...!
Gwahahaha... You do well with only two machines... Tetsuya Tsurugi.
But your resistance ends here!
Great Mazinger!?
How's this, Tetsuya Tsurugi! With the data from our battles so far,
we have built Great Mazinger with our own hands!
Oh no...
Heh... You think something like that will work on me?
It's nothing but a copy...!
We may have built them, but they are still Great Mazinger...
You know better than anyone that its power is not to be taken lightly.
And you know what happens when this many are gathered together!
Go forth, Great Mazinger Corps!
Garada K7, support them with a full volley!
You came for us!? Everyone else too?
We rushed over to back you up!
So this... is Bardos Island...
The ruins where the Star of La Mu was felt a lot like this, too.
We're all set to sortie, Commander!
Shall we head out into battle, Lady Aina?
Yes... Let's neither of us push too hard... You too, Shiro.
Yeah, I'll make it back to the Gran Garan in one piece.
This is the enemy's main base... There's no telling what may happen.
Everyone, stay on your guard! All hands, sortie!
So this is the final battle with Mykene at last.
With us storming their home base, they must be pretty surprised.
Don't think you'll be going home in one piece.
Fuhahaha... Fools, coming all this way just to die.
That's my line!
Let's go, Koji!
Yeah! Let's show 'em the power of the Double Mazingers!
Koji...?
So long, Baron Ashura. I'll send Dr. Hell to the same place real soon...!
That's when our fight... will truly be settled...!
There's no next time, Brocken. We've got to keep moving forward...!
Curse you, how dare you...
I shall avenge Baron Ashura and Count Brocken!
There's still more coming?
What is that thing!?
Way too big to be an octopus...
That is... Dragonosaurus...
It's said to be a survivor of the marine life that lived on the ancient seabed...
You know a lot about it, don't you?
It's said to have grown huge from a diet of petroleum.
Heh... So its belly is basically an oil tank.
So they made it a Mechanical Beast... Just like Dr. Hell to think of that.
Units low on energy, please return to the battleships for now...
We are ready to resupply you.
The BACKUP is OK too!
This is the enemy's main base, after all. More of them will show up...
Conserve your strength while you take out the enemy!
You make it sound so easy, geez.
Griping won't end this fight, you know...
All we can do is push through.
Nngh, impressive... To think you'd get this far.
There you are!
We came all the way to your home base, so you should be grateful.
As I promised, today looks like the last day of the Mykene Empire.
You won't get away with this.
Heh, talk is cheap!
We shall show you the true might of Mykene!
Another new enemy...!?
The enemy's resistance is fierce, as expected...
Pretty timid of you, Holy Warrior!
Holy Warrior, sir, you mustn't lose heart.
Let us take this place in one fell swoop.
That's right. With this momentum, we can do it!
You should've just stayed put. Now get ready!
What was that about? Going to see "Kabuto" at the end?
He probably went to see my grandpa...
Grandpa and Hell used to be research partners, after all...
Koji...
...So long, Dr. Hell... Say hi to Grandpa for me.
...We won.
You did it, Tetsuya!
Yeah. The Great General of Darkness... was one tough opponent...
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
It seems it's finally over.
Good work, everyone.
The feud that started back in Grandpa's day... It's finally over.
All the hardship Tetsuya and I endured, raised to defeat Mykene...
It's finally paid off...
Yeah, that's right... But our fight isn't over yet...
At a time like this... you oughta just be happy about it.
That'd be more like you, Tetsuya.
Anyway, Mykene's beaten... so that's one less enemy force.
With the Mykene Empire gone, the only enemy based on the surface left
is the Demon Empire, I guess.
For now, all we can do is crush them one by one...
Right... That's why the Ra Cailum and Nadesico went to the Moon and Mars
for us, after all.
